text:
jessicaw: forwarding from customer (ryan) - streaming generator hangs intermittently when auth token rotates. reported impact: app stalls for 10-20s then resumes. using python sdk 0.9.1. request id=req-0a1b2c3d, endpoint=/v1/stream (hosted).

samir: can you paste the minimal repro and any raw tcp/sse fragments? particularly interested if keepalive/204s show up.

jessicaw: pasted below, customer sent raw capture. they said it happens after token rotation (we rotate every 30m).

jessicaw: ```
# simplified client loop
with RedwoodClient(api_key=ROTATING_TOKEN) as c:
    for chunk in c.stream("reply", model="rwd-2b", prompt=p):
        print(chunk)
# output stops mid-response, generator never yields final chunk until timeout
```

jessicaw: raw SSE fragments (tcp dump):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: text/event-stream

id: 42
data: {"type":"delta","delta":"Hello, wo"}

id: 42
data: {"type":"delta","delta":"rld!"}

# after auth refresh, customer observed a 204 keepalive without delimiter
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
# then server resumes with a partial event (split across packets)
data: {"type":"delta","delta":"par
```

jessicaw: then nothing until ~15s later:
```
tial"}

id: 42
data: {"type":"done"}

```

alex_oncall: interesting — looks like a partial token (`par` / `tial`) split with a 204 in between. our parser expects event boundary ("\n\n") before treating the event as complete. if a 204 arrives in the middle we might be erroneously pausing the generator.

eli_sre: can you confirm SDK version? any header differences? also need server side request-id and timestamp from logs.

jessicaw: sdk==0.9.1. headers from client: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` `Connection: keep-alive` `Accept: text/event-stream`
server logs (short): `req-0a1b2c3d start stream`, `token-refresh triggered for customer-42`, `emit keepalive 204`, `resume stream` timestamps 2026-11-02T14:12:01Z -> 14:12:02Z -> 14:12:03Z

samir: assigning to eng, tagging this as P1 for customer impact. initial guess: SSE parser in python sdk treats 204 keepalives as full stop for parsing loop when the connection state flips, leading to blocking on generator until next newline-delimited event. i can reproduce locally by injecting a 204 between fragmented data frames.

samir: repro steps I used:
1) run local mock that sends `data: {"delta":"par` then send a `204` response, then send `tial"}`
2) use python sdk 0.9.1 stream helper -> generator blocks

samir: quick workaround for customer: downgrade token rotation to avoid mid-fragment refresh, or use short-lived keepalive disabled flag. also we can suggest `client.stream(..., chunk_timeout=5)` if available to fail faster.

support-bot: added label: escalation/sse-streaming and priority:P1

alex_oncall: root cause tracked: `python-sse-parser` in SDK didn't handle interleaved control responses (204) while a fragmented `data:` line is mid-buffer. fix: buffer till full event delimiter across connection state changes and treat 204 as noop for in-flight events.

samir: patch landed on branch `fix/sse-204-fragment` and validated against unit tests and tcp-sim reproduction. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/412 (internal).

samir: customer-facing mitigation: upgraded hosted API router to avoid emitting 204 during token rotation for 2ndary tenants (deployed to prod-us-1 at 2026-11-03T02:00Z). also cut a python SDK patch 0.9.2 with backport, and 0.10.2 will contain the full fix and regression tests.

jessicaw: passing 0.9.2 binary to customer now, asking them to test. they confirmed patch reduces hangs in initial run (still seeing 1 in 20).

eli_sre: follow-up: we're adding extra logging to track `event_buffer_length` and keepalive interleaves in production. also adding an integration test that injects 204 in the middle of fragmented `data:` events.

samir: note for release notes: `python-sdk 0.9.2 — fix(sse): handle 204 keepalive during fragmented SSE event to avoid generator hangs; recommend upgrade for streaming-heavy apps.`

jessicaw: customer confirmed full fix after upgrade to 0.10.2 next day, closing escalation. :tada:

alex_oncall: marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
